limitations: The current execution environment exposes GitHub repository and Actions capabilities but no authorized Codex Desktop/CLI native agent-spawn surface.

Smoke v2 requires a single-child native run with explicit fork_turns=none. The prepared worker is also instructed not to spawn subagents, so the PH-03 isolation proof does not depend on current parallel-subagent isolation behavior.

requestedRole=context_companion and requestedAuthority=read_only describe the semantic launch request; they are not treated as proof that Codex applied a named runtime role, model, or tool policy. Runtime role/model metadata remain informational and explicitly unobserved unless the host exposes them.

The append-only preparation bundle, exact worker-handoff digest, parent-sentinel digest, parent-artifact binding, smokeVersion/packetVersion 2 contract, and fail-closed validator make a future native smoke reproducible and tamper-evident but do not prove that a native worker was spawned or isolated.

Explicit fork_turns=none, single-child execution, parent-marker isolation, schema-valid live worker ContextDelta, and no-repository-write behavior require a native Codex live smoke and are not inferred from unit tests, generated bundles, validator fixtures, or GitHub Actions evidence.
